description: Runs the quality gates and an independent review on any video before anyone sees it: grounding read of every claim, voice gate, hyperframes check, reading time per line, stills at mid-transitions and at phone width, 1:1 zoom on images, render and encode settings, loudness and true peak, sound against picture, frozen and black frames, one-frame glitches at every cut (ghost, black or held frames, late cuts), the poster frame, a transcript of the finished file, and a review by fresh subagents that grade defects P0/P1/P2. An executor under video-studio. Use when a film is rendered and before it is shown, or when video-studio reaches its gates. Triggers: "check the video", "QA the film", "review the film", "what is wrong with this video", "check the render", "seam scan".
